pages.heading: Hi, I'm Júlia
lines: I'm a senior product designer, and I've been designing digital products since 2018. I've worked across fintech, quick-service restaurants, consulting and education, and today I'm at Ambush, a consultancy, designing for global clients.

Whatever the industry, my work sits in the same place: where user needs, business goals and product growth meet. I get there through thoughtful design decisions, experimentation and outcomes we can measure.

pages.heading: How it started
lines: I've always loved creating things on the computer, but design became a path when I started studying Visual Design at UFRGS. In parallel, I worked as a freelance branding designer.

My first step into tech was at UFRGS's education and technology center, working on an RPG that taught children what it's like to live as an older person. Then I joined Kobe Apps, a software house, as an intern, and that's where I fell in love with product design.

pages.heading: What I've learned along the way
lines: After Kobe, I spent several years in fintech, at investment companies like XP and Warren. Then I joined Ambush, where I design for international clients in fintech and food service.

pages.heading: What I've learned along the way
lines: Working in consultancy put me in front of different markets, business models and product stages. It taught me to handle complexity, adapt fast, and design for both what customers need and what operations can actually deliver.
Today I'm especially drawn to user research, experimentation, growth strategy and scalable design operations.

pages.heading: Beyond work
lines: Outside of work, I read, draw, go to the gym, and do yoga and pilates. I play chess whenever I can, and I love traveling to discover new places.
